invariants.rationale: instantTime is intended to represent a commit instant, and null would be invalid for time-based record operations.
The method expects a list of records to upsert; a null list would typically be invalid.
HoodieEngineContext is required to perform the operation; null context would not be usable.
Commit instants in Hudi are non-empty strings representing timestamps.
The size of preppedRecords should never be negative; this is a consequence of valid Java List contracts.
